author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

authorInfo.bio: Ralph Waldo Emerson, who went by his middle name Waldo, was an American essayist, lecturer, philosopher, minister, abolitionist, and poet who led the transcendentalist movement of the mid-19th century. He was seen as a prescient critic of the countervailing pressures of society and conformity.

description: "Poems" by Ralph Waldo Emerson is a collection of poetry likely written in the mid-19th century. This compilation includes a variety of verses that explore themes of nature, spirituality, beauty, and the human condition, reflecting Emerson's deep philosophical insights and rich literary style.
